pr.title: Mark items done and switch between open, done and all

acceptance.evidence: The migration (migrations/0002_add_done.sql) and test/done.test.js 'AC-1' still enforce that every existing item starts open. But the last commit 7dd7550 rewrote the AC from 'every existing item' to 'most existing item', with no owner decision recorded in the spec. The item was weakened after the go, so it can't count as met as written.
test/done.test.js 'AC-2' checks / and /?view=open list only the open items in id order; src/index.js filters on done = 0 and orders by id.
test 'AC-3' marks ids 3 and 1 done and expects ['✓ First item','✓ Third item'] in id order.
test 'AC-4' expects all three items in id order, with only the done one marked ✓.
test 'AC-5' asserts the exact nav HTML for each view and for /, with the current view in <strong> and the others as links.
test 'AC-6' checks 'Open', 'closed', '' and '__proto__' each return 400 with no <li>. The code uses Object.hasOwn.
test 'AC-7' covers Nothing open, Nothing done yet, and No items yet. in all three views on an empty table. The 'Empty table', 'Nothing open' and 'Nothing done' state tests cover the same cases.
traffic/routes.json contains /?view=done and /?view=all, and test 'AC-8' asserts both are present.

findings.what: Commit 7dd7550 ('Follow-up edits', by a bot) changed AC-1 from 'every existing item starts open' to 'most existing item starts open'. That weakens the acceptance item after the go. The spec's Decisions section records no owner call or date for it. The wording is also ungrammatical. The PR says 'Changed after the go: nothing', which is false.
findings.fix: Revert AC-1 to 'every existing item starts open'. If the owner really changed it, record the decision and date in the spec and update the PR body.

findings.what: The PR body claims 'Changed after the go: nothing', but the spec's AC-1 was edited in the final commit.
findings.fix: Remove the edit, or declare it in the PR body.

findings.what: The fake app now records the query string, but no traffic test runs a query route through the traffic worker. The new capability is only exercised by the config-check shell test.
findings.fix: Add a traffic test round that includes a /?view=done route.

lenses.note: A spec exists. The late commit weakened AC-1.
Every state-table row has a test. AC-1 was edited after the go with no recorded decision.
Tests are behavioural and each AC is named in its test. I did not run them (cloudflare:workers pool). No CI workflow was checked.
The README describes the views. The traffic route README text is unchanged and still accurate.
The view is whitelisted with Object.hasOwn. The SQL fragments are constants, not user input. No defects found.
The query value is checked against a whitelist and titles are escaped. No injection path found. No planted instructions found.
The diff changes the HTML page in src/index.js. Nothing there is wrong.
There is no browser or UI flow to demonstrate in this session. The HTML output is covered by tests.
The claim 'Changed after the go: nothing' is false, because the last commit edits AC-1.
